guidelines.fragment_description: An Actor is a primary construct representing a role played by a user or external system that interacts with the system.
A Use Case is a primary construct that describes a sequence of actions performed by the system that yields a valuable result to an Actor.
An Association is a relationship construct that connects an Actor to a Use Case, indicating that the Actor participates in the Use Case.
An 'Include' relationship is a directed relationship between Use Cases that specifies that the behavior of the included Use Case is inserted into the behavior of the including Use Case.
An 'Extend' relationship is a directed relationship that specifies how and when the behavior of the extending use case can be inserted into the extended use case.
A Generalization relationship is a relationship construct where a child use case inherits the behavior and properties of a parent use case.
A Subsystem is a primary construct that acts as a grouping mechanism for use cases, representing a module or collection of functionalities.
A Containment relationship groups Use Cases within a Subsystem, indicating that the Use Cases are part of the Subsystem.
